punchline: Interviews recorded on the promise of secrecy until death were pulled into court within years.
thirty_sec: Jean McConville, a mother of ten, was taken from her Belfast home in 1972 and her fate went unspoken for decades. Her remains were found in 2003. Meanwhile Boston College recorded interviews with former paramilitaries on the promise of keeping them sealed until death. In 2011 legal action over those tapes began. Patrick Radden Keefe tells this in Say Nothing.
